clues: This town is a department capital in Honduras. It serves as the chief town of its department.
This town is famed for the coolest climate in Honduras. Its air stays cooler than anywhere else there.
This town is the newer of two twin towns. The older twin began as a Lenca town.
Lenca hands still shape fine clay pots here. A marked trail links towns that keep this craft alive.
Two towns here have grown into one city. You cannot tell where one ends and the next begins.
